svg.title: Production runtime dataflow
svg.desc: Flowchart showing external providers, production runtime owners and worker, and persisted datastore or artifact boundaries.
svg.text: Production runtime owners and owned worker

path.title: DB → CME: CME schemas and records
DB → A: equity OHLCV schemas
FMP → A: corporate, macro, commodity, filing metadata
FRED → A: GDP/CPI/unemployment/FEDFUNDS observations
SCH → A: stock quotes and price history
SCH → O: option chains
SEC → A: filing document text
CME → CH: partitioned events, cursors, L2 snapshot
CME → CF: derived hourly cross-asset features
A → AD: normalized provider data and calculated features
A → AR: exact one-minute bar readiness manifest/receipt
A → AC: completed cycle authority
P → PT: target-causal valuations
P → W: launch after fast target publication
AD → W: point-in-time FEDFUNDS observations
OS → W: committed chain history
W → PW: causal residual samples, model generation, status
PW → P: prior local shadow model/materialization
P → PR: full pricing generations and compact surfaces
O → OP: unready raw responses
OP → O: reconcile when exact readiness arrives
O → OS: immutable chain and option-quality snapshot
B → BR: directional run and atomic current pointer
S → SR: ranked candidates, audit, reports, receipt
AR → P: exact-target readiness contract
AR → O: commit-versus-pending readiness contract
AC → B: complete-cycle barrier
PT → O: exact-target pricing barrier
AD → P: completed bars + point-in-time rates
AD → O: daily bars for realized volatility
AD → B: bars, technicals, fundamentals, signals, quote, macro, energy, SEC
AD → S: underlying stock BBO quote-liquidity
CF → B: cme__ cross-asset features
OS → P: lagged IV, contracts, reconciliation samples
OS → B: opt__ option-quality features
OS → S: entry/exit chains and observed BBO outcomes
PR → B: opx__ compact pricing surfaces
PT → S: receipt-proven target pricing predictions
PR → S: receipt-proven pricing predictions/surfaces
PW → S: offline replay reader; current empty-materialization load fails
BR → S: published samples, directional probabilities, receipt
